query: SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?itemLabel ?sitelinks WHERE { { ?item wdt:P1056 wd:Q2024731 . } UNION { ?item wdt:P452 wd:Q2024731 . } UNION { ?item wdt:P1056/wdt:P279 wd:Q2024731 . } ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 1000
